protocol.update_frequency: first day of each formal month
protocol.forecast_score: mean price-weighted absolute error per period
protocol.risk_budget_rule: remaining emergency budget / remaining formal calendar days
protocol.risk_selection: minimum surrogate cost among historically budget-feasible candidates; otherwise minimum emergency bound
protocol.reserve_score: actual validation total cost with continuous SOC and identical full-SOC endpoints
protocol.tie_rule: scores rounded to 8 decimals, then increasing degree/window/quantile/radius
